resources.string: Each workspace is a separate budget with its own accounts, categories and transactions (e.g. \"Monthly budget\", \"Family vacation\"). Share a workspace with as many people as you want: everyone keeps it in sync through a file in Google Drive (or any cloud storage on your phone).
To share: tap Share and save the file in a Google Drive folder. Share that folder with the other members in Google Drive. Each of them taps \"Join a shared workspace\" and picks the same file.
How the other members will see you
Ivy Wallet will restart to open this workspace.
All its data on this phone will be deleted. Other members keep their copy.
